page.overview:
Who is Ratchet?

The name Ratchet has been applied to multiple Transformers characters.

"Ratchet" is also the Japanese name for Armada Red Alert.

A ratchet is also a type of joint used in the construction of Transformers toys.

Also known as: Autobot medic.
